question: 用户次日内、7日内、30日内退款率分别如何
gold_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(CASE WHEN julianday(r.refund_time) - julianday(o.order_time) <= 1 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS next_day_refund_rate,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN julianday(r.refund_time) - julianday(o.order_time) <= 7 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS within_7days_refund_rate,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN julianday(r.refund_time) - julianday(o.order_time) <= 30 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS within_30days_refund_rate
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE r.status = '已退款' OR r.refund_id IS NULL
raw_output:
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(r.refund_time) - julianday(o.order_time) <= 1 THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已完成', '已退款')) AS "次日内退款率",
  SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(r.refund_time) - julianday(o.order_time) <= 7 THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已完成', '已退款')) AS "7日内退款率",
  SUM(CASE WHEN julianday(r.refund_time) - julianday(o.order_time) <= 30 THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已完成', '已退款')) AS "30日内退款率"
FROM refunds r
JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE r.status = '已退款'
